notes.title: Bug fixes and Korean language translation (BETA).
notes.content:
[p]The game has received a Korean translation thanks to user X: [b]HingHingman[/b]. The translation was done using artificial intelligence, so it might be inaccurate in some places. Because of this, the translation will be marked as [b]BETA[/b] until it is verified by someone or adjusted by the player community. Nevertheless, I decided to add the translation to the game because I believe it will make the game accessible to more players! I greatly appreciate your attention and the opportunity to give players a new gaming experience.

A small number of issues have been fixed in the game, including:[/p][olist][*][p]Added missing text in places where only Cyrillic was present and English text was absent.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some significant issues in enemy battles, including the lack of interface in fights with multiple enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the elevator explosion scene at the end of Chapter 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Mulf in the conference room: now when he dies or loses, he appears to the player instead of becoming invisible.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bugs and rough edges have also been fixed.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Game Update! Doors!
notes.content: [p]A new option to speed up door animations has been added to the menu. You can enable it if you want the door animations to play faster.[/p][p]Fixed a bug where puppet deaths did not affect the ending.[/p]

notes.title: Quick bug fixes. If you encounter any issues, please contact support.
notes.content:
[p][b]Quick bug fixes. If you encounter any issues, please contact support — I resolve problems very quickly.[/b]

The error "loading error failed to load: data/Map055.json" has been fixed. Apologies for my oversight — the demo version is now stable again.
[u] I will also regularly release patches to fix issues reported by the community on Steam. Rest assured, I respond to all requests and work on every bug.

notes.title: Mind Control: Bloody Renaissance
notes.content:
Hello, my name is PicBot Iq54. For 6 years I have been developing my biggest and most ambitious game "Mind Control: Bloody Renaissance". Mind Control is a very personal project. The gameplay is a psychological horror with detective elements and a rail shooter-like combat system. I was inspired by the classics of Survior horror games, Suda51 and Swery65 games as well as Human Entertainment games.

The game has several endings, random event system, complex karma system, several mini-games.


The demo shows only a small part of the game's content and mechanics. Add the game to your wishlist to support the project.


Thank you for your attention!

notes.title: New English translation!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44265909/c4b4650440ce6509d6296c89ac8e4cbe7b1181df.png[/img]
[h2]New translation of the game prepared together with ParadiseHotel51.[/h2] 

[url=https://www.paradisehotel51.com]Paradisehotel51[/url] will help me to prepare a new version of English translation of [b]Mind Control: Bloody Renaissance[/b]. New better translation will make the game available for more players! At the moment is ready to update the translation for the demo version, which I will add in the next update. If you haven't played the game yet, I recommend you to do it right after the update! At the moment the game is technically ready and is at the post-production stage. We are polishing and searching for bugs as well as translating the game into English. Follow the game in our social networks and add the game to your wishlist. I will be very grateful to you if you tell your friends about the game.

[h3]Many thanks to ParadiseHotel51 for your help with the translation![/h3]
